The board watched a recorded presentation on shifting trust and stabilization funds from the state's conservative "legal list" to a "prudent investor" standard, but has not yet sent letters to the investment firm or the treasurer for more information.

why_it_matters: A dispute between an appointed board and the town manager over document access and a vacant seat can slow oversight of trust funds that fund things like scholarships.
Whether the town adopts the newer "prudent investor" investment standard, versus the more conservative rule it uses now, affects how much trust and stabilization money can grow over time.
The unfilled third seat leaves the two-member commission without a quorum cushion for future votes on these funds.
